our_title: 3df345a8 mesh/torus size checks overflow and accept wrapped sizes; torus API unchecked
ran: Kits: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-playground/925301e5-494b-5a33-b598-8eaa63dd5c1d/scratchpad/work18/G03-arch-mesh-deco-misc/repro (7.0.17 kits; new/*.tgt, new/torusapi.c (mesh/torus builders), COR-20/run18.sh; transcript RESULTS18.txt). Pristine = INFRA/asan(64); patched = /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-playground/925301e5-494b-5a33-b598-8eaa63dd5c1d/scratchpad/work18/G03-arch-mesh-deco-misc/build(64) (ASan+UBSan); bin/atst and bin/gmap. See COR-21: 'mesh2D 100000 50000' accepted after 'arch_mesh.c:127:41: runtime error: signed integer overflow', then atst allocates 0x690edd000 bytes; torusapi 't2 0 5' -> ret=0 size=0, 'tx 0 4' -> ret=0, 'mx 2 0 4' -> ret=0 size=0. Patched (0001): all rejected.

fix_options.label: A. Division idiom and missing parameter checks (0001)

upstream_fix_review.details: Right: archMeshXArchLoad() now rejects dimnnbr < 1 (arch_mesh.c:651), which fixes the meshXD half of COR-07 ('meshXD 0', 'meshXD -1', 'torusXD 0' -> 'archMeshXArchLoad: bad input (1)', verified); SCOTCH_archMesh2/3/X() now reject non-positive sizes and dimension counts; every loader/builder has a size check. Wrong: the check '(archsiz * c) < archsiz' (arch_mesh.c:127,408-409,667; library_arch.c:399,444-445,494,643,681-682,723) computes the overflowing signed product (UBSan) and misses wraps to a larger value: 'mesh2D 100000 50000' -> 'arch_mesh.c:127:41: runtime error: signed integer overflow' then accepted, and atst tries to allocate 0x690edd000 bytes; SCOTCH_archMesh2/Torus2 (100000, 50000) accepted with UBSan at library_arch.c:399/674. Missing: SCOTCH_archTorus2/3/X() do not reject non-positive sizes (torusapi 't2 0 5' -> ret=0 size=0) and SCOTCH_archTorusX() accepts dimnnbr <= 0 ('tx 0 4' -> ret=0), SCOTCH_archMeshX() never checks c[0] ('mx 2 0 4' -> ret=0 size=0); the cmpltw/cmpltws weight sums (arch_cmpltw.c:188, 259) are still unchecked ('cmpltw 2 2000000000 2000000000' -> 'signed integer overflow: 2000000000 + 2000000000').
upstream_fix_review.compared_with_ours: Our 7.0.17 0002 used the ANUMMAX division idiom in the three loaders and covered cmpltw sums; it did not touch the API builders (his commit adds those, which is better). Rebased 0001 keeps his loader/builder checks, replaces the product comparisons by the division idiom, and adds the missing torus/meshX parameter checks and the cmpltw sums.

fix_options.label: A. Restore '||' (0003)
fix_options.summary: A name is a standard stream only if it is exactly "-".

upstream_fix_review.details: Right: names default to "-", so 'dummysizes < /dev/null' and the one-argument form no longer dereference NULL; newline added to error messages. Wrong: the standard-stream test was changed from '||' to '&&' (dummysizes.c:231-232), so any one-character file name is taken for a standard stream: 'dummysizes h o < /dev/null' reads stdin, writes stdout and creates no file 'o' (verified; 'lib.h out2.h' works). Missing: the line length test still reads chartab[CHARMAX - 1] (dummysizes.c:368), so a 2046-character line is reported 'line too long'; the SCOTCH_DEBUG_MAIN1 block (dummysizes.c:408-414) still uses .name/.pntr and does not compile (3 errors). Header date not bumped.
upstream_fix_review.compared_with_ours: Our 7.0.17 0005 set the default names and fixed the line test and the debug block, and kept '||'. His version adds the newlines to messages (better). Rebased: 0003 restores '||' (new defect PS3-G03-2), 0004 keeps our remainder.
